artifact.title: The Pathfinder ticket lifecycle
artifact.subtitle: The states a ticket occupies, who moves it, and where the status lives
artifact.summary: Four states and two exits. Every transition below is performed by one of the four ticket actions, and none of them is performed by the agent deciding its own work is done.

groups.label: The delivery loop
groups.summary: One ticket at a time. A session that finishes a ticket stops there.

groups.label: Terminal states
groups.summary: Reopening terminal work is the human's decision, never an action's.

nodes.label: The human
nodes.summary: Approval, acceptance, merge and release are the human's, whichever action is running.

nodes.label: Proposed
nodes.summary: Written by to-tickets and nothing else. Not yet approved for execution.

nodes.label: Ready
nodes.summary: Every blocker is Complete and the human has approved execution.
detail: Readiness is not an ordering. File order, ticket number, and the order the tickets were written are not dependencies; only a blocker that is Complete makes a ticket ready.

nodes.label: In Progress
nodes.summary: A session holds it. Recorded before the first file edit, never after.

nodes.label: Review
nodes.summary: Verification against the ticket and its parent Feature. Review writes no status and accepts nothing.

nodes.label: Complete
nodes.summary: Work the human has accepted, delivered through the project's workflow.

nodes.label: Cancelled
nodes.summary: A terminal alternative, alongside Superseded. Neither is a failure state.

nodes.label: Ticket store
nodes.summary: One place, configured per project. There is never a second copy to reconcile.

nodes.label: Parent Feature
nodes.summary: Its status is derived from its tickets and never maintained by hand.

paths.label: A clean run
paths.note: Four transitions, each performed by a different action, and the last one only after a human has accepted the work.

paths.label: Review sends it back
paths.note: Review reports findings and changes no implementation, so the ticket returns to the session that holds it rather than to a new one.

views.label: Where the human decides
views.note: Two gates, and neither is an agent's to pass on its own.
